top_findings: No robots.txt (404 at both domain root and project path)
No XML sitemap at any conventional location
No canonical URL on any of the 11 pages
No og:image / twitter:image while using summary_large_image
Zero structured data (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication all missing)
8 of 11 meta descriptions exceed the SERP snippet
Open Graph tags are identical on every page
No contextual internal links (nav and footer only)
Site is served from a github.io subpath, not cognilogs.com
No content surface beyond 11 marketing pages
quick_wins: Ship robots.ts and sitemap.ts (2 files, ~30 minutes)
Add self-referencing canonicals via a shared metadata helper
Generate a 1200x630 social image and wire og:image

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS with HSTS and a valid certificate
Single-hop 301 for http->https and for missing trailing slash
Static server-rendered HTML: 1565 words without JavaScript

findings.title: robots.txt missing
findings.description: https://cognilogs.github.io/robots.txt and /landing/robots.txt both return 404. No crawl policy, no sitemap declaration, no AI-usage stance.
findings.recommendation: Add app/robots.ts returning allow-all rules plus the sitemap URL. Note that robots.txt is only honoured at the domain root, which GitHub Pages project sites cannot serve - resolve by moving to cognilogs.com.

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: sitemap_discovery.py found no sitemap at /sitemap.xml, /sitemap_index.xml, /sitemap-index.xml or /wp-sitemap.xml.
findings.recommendation: Add app/sitemap.ts listing all 11 URLs with lastModified, changeFrequency and priority.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: 0 of 11 pages declare a canonical URL while the site is served from a github.io project subpath.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing absolute canonicals through one shared metadata helper.

findings.title: Site not served from the brand domain
findings.description: cognilogs.com resolves (GoDaddy nameservers) but TLS fails with unrecognized name and it does not serve this site. The canonical home is cognilogs.github.io/landing/.
findings.recommendation: Point cognilogs.com at the deployment (CNAME + DNS) and drop the /landing base path.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 11 unique titles and 11 unique single H1s with clean H1->H2 nesting

findings.title: Meta descriptions overrun on 8 of 11 pages
findings.recommendation: Trim each to <=155 characters, front-loading the differentiating clause.

findings.title: Two titles underperform
findings.description: /features is 'Product | cognilogs' (19 chars, no keyword). /comparison is 81 chars and truncates before the competitor names.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite both to <=60 characters with the primary keyword first.

findings.title: Open Graph identical on every page, no image
findings.description: og:title and og:description on inner pages are byte-identical to the homepage because Next.js shallowly overwrites nested metadata. og:image and twitter:image are absent while twitter:card is summary_large_image.
findings.recommendation: Define per-page openGraph/twitter blocks through the shared helper and generate a 1200x630 social image.

findings.title: Internal linking limited to nav and footer
findings.description: 11 unique internal links on the homepage, all from navigation and footer, with generic anchor text. No body copy links to /features, /comparison or /docs.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 contextual in-body links per page with descriptive anchor text.

findings.title: Zero structured data
findings.description: 0 JSON-LD blocks, 0 microdata, 0 RDFa across all pages.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization + WebSite + SoftwareApplication sitewide and BreadcrumbList on inner pages. Do not add FAQPage: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites on 7 May 2026.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Specific, evidence-led copy naming real thresholds and constraints
No thin pages; lowest is 630 words

findings.title: No informational content surface
findings.description: 11 marketing pages and no blog, glossary or query-shaped pages. The site can only win brand queries today.
findings.recommendation: Publish 6-8 pages targeting informational and comparison intent, linked from /docs and the footer.

findings.title: No author or freshness signals
findings.description: No bylines, no named founders, no publication or update dates, no sameAs links.
findings.recommendation: Name the team on /about with sameAs links and add datePublished/dateModified to content pages.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Absent. Google Search ignores llms.txt per its own guidance.
findings.recommendation: Optional: add /llms.txt with an H1, a summary block and Markdown links for non-Google agents.

categories.name: Performance (lab CWV)
what_works: LCP 1.98 s and CLS 0.006 on emulated mid-range Android

findings.title: TBT above the good threshold
findings.description: 269 ms total blocking time across 4 long tasks from 10 JS chunks plus framer-motion hydration.
findings.recommendation: Defer non-critical client components and split the heaviest chunks; target TBT < 200 ms.

findings.title: 245 KB of HTML per page
findings.description: 99 inline SVG icons on the homepage are duplicated through nav, footer and sections on every page.
findings.recommendation: Share icon definitions rather than inlining them per instance.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Definition-style opening and a comparison table
Explicit thresholds and intervals that are quotable

findings.title: No entity scaffolding
findings.description: No schema, no sameAs, no author or date signals; nothing for an LLM to attach the brand to.
findings.recommendation: Ship the entity schema first; entity presence is the highest-leverage GEO fix available on-site.

findings.title: No off-site brand presence
findings.description: No Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn or Wikipedia presence found; brand mentions correlate more strongly with AI citation than backlinks.
findings.recommendation: Treat as a distribution programme, not a code change.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No content images to optimise; all icons are labelled or aria-hidden

findings.title: No social preview image
findings.description: No og:image or twitter:image exists anywhere on the site.
findings.recommendation: Design a 1200x630 image in the existing visual language and reference it from the root metadata.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Create and wire the 1200x630 social image

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Per-page Open Graph and Twitter metadata
Add Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD

phases.name: Phase 3: Domain and Authority
items: Serve the site at cognilogs.com and drop the /landing base path
Name the team on /about with sameAs links

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring and Iteration
items: Search Console and Bing Webmaster setup with sitemap submission
Re-run the audit with Google API keys for CrUX and GSC field data
